WITH copies_by_rating AS (
  SELECT f.rating, COUNT(i.inventory_id) AS copy_count
  FROM film AS f
  LEFT JOIN inventory AS i ON i.film_id = f.film_id
  GROUP BY f.rating
),
average_copies AS (
  SELECT AVG(copy_count) AS avg_copy_count
  FROM copies_by_rating
)
SELECT SUM(c.copy_count) AS total_copies,
       AVG(c.copy_count - a.avg_copy_count) AS avg_excess_copies
FROM copies_by_rating AS c
CROSS JOIN average_copies AS a
WHERE c.copy_count > a.avg_copy_count
